input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there

errors: First smoke run failed pickling `fly` for the scoring pool: wrappers must live in the experiment's own __main__ module (as 7ae does), not be passed as AE.fly; fixed before the full run.
Loading an experiment run.py with `import run` collides with experiments/m6_poshold/run.py on sys.path; load it with importlib under another name.

doc_friction.issue: --until defaults to a 100 s timeout and exits 0 with 'still failing' text, so a background `wait_for ... ; grep` reports completion without the condition met; pass --timeout 540 explicitly.

Each milestone's .cache/ training directory is neither committed nor gitignored, so the stop hook flags it as untracked during long runs; added a local .git/info/exclude entry. A research/.gitignore line for experiments/*/.cache*/ would save the next run this.

deviations.why: pick_track flagged 31 sub-steps of milestone 7 and suggested a paper step might serve better; the draft already covered 7ad/7ae, and 7ae named the step objective as the one open question, so I ran that milestone and used the ~2 h training wait to land the paper's outstanding figures VII-a/VII-b.
deviations.did: one experiment milestone plus a paper-figure step in the same PR
deviations.result: both landed; the experiment overturned 7ae's reading, which the draft now records

notes: Predictions committed in 3dbb3a805 before the full run. 9 predictions, 7 held (AF3 kp rises and AF8 overshoot <= 3 cm refuted). Step term: rise 1.83 -> 1.41 s pooled (p = 3.7e-05), crashes 97 vs 107 of 2304 (p = 0.84), 12/12 certified and settled; kd 6.52 -> 4.65; Spearman(kd, rise) 0.999 over 36 designs; post hoc rise = 0.90*0.9 m/(A_P/kd) + 0.33 s, r 0.9994. Overshoot 4.7-5.3 cm vs 1.1-1.8. Training 6662 s on 4 cores. Local checks: 14 targeted pytest pass (paper numbers, 7ad, 7ae, 7af), paper/check_numbers.py 71/71, homepage build ok, research_live_links, check_md_links, check_posts ok. No new citations.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
